title: Advanced Spatial Geometry & Round-Trip
selected_by_owner: Owner issued Continue after MMHT-14 in the established Map Maker HTML Tester conversation, authorizing the approved final MMHT-15 review cycle.

in_scope: Author exact polygon-with-holes and cubic-Bezier sidecar geometry with stable IDs, independent affine transforms, map-unit measurements and visibility controls, while retaining prior map feature and spatial link data.
Provide validation of malformed rings, hole crossing/overlap, curve segment continuity, transform bounds, related feature IDs and map levels; preserve undo and source revision identity.

Provide complete editable map exports, filtered GM/player map references, geometry exchange with preview/explicit apply and integrity diagnostic, and local planar GeoJSON-style output with exact authoring extensions.

Deliver four editable sample maps, twenty browser-exported JSON records, independent cross-system handoff and round-trip browser tests; finish 15-cycle prototype review program without combining independent gameplay engines.
boundaries: Standalone HTML map authoring and reference exports only; no topological movement/portal execution, resource production, ecological simulation, terrain physics, ownership or other gameplay outcome.
Affine measurements are in map units and polygon hole area is an arithmetic planar calculation, not shape union, GIS georeferencing or engine collision certification.
FNV-1a is a non-cryptographic corruption diagnostic, not authentication; browser player export is not production authorization.

Chromium Playwright set_content and file input/download tests do not prove direct file:// navigation (blocked by harness administrator), physical Android/Windows, installed Unity, online sync or owner acceptance.

evidence.sample_artifacts: Cycle15 ZIP includes standalone HTML, four full editable drafts and GM/player/geometry-exchange/GeoJSON companion files for each sample, README, handoff, screenshot previews, sample index, SHA256SUMS and executed tests.
evidence.validation: Node --check accepted embedded JavaScript. Chromium Playwright set_content loaded all four examples with documentError null and no page errors. UI affine rotation/reflection scaled measured net polygon area by correct determinant while leaving prior map features and nonEuclideanLinks unchanged. Rejected self-crossing rings and holes outside exterior without mutation. Saved coordinate validation and exact cubic-Bezier controls. Exported a geometry exchange in browser, changed a shape, inspected saved import without mutation, explicitly applied and recovered exact shape array. Rejected modified fingerprint and foreign map ID. GeoJSON extension carried exact canonical authoring shape data. GM-only shape IDs/geometry/notes absent from player map projections. Full native draft exports and file-input reimport recovered advanced geometry as separate copy for regional and Carnival documents, including Carnival topology endpoint map-ID remapping. Four clean samples exported 20 actual browser JSON files; exporter isolated Chrome automatic multi-download quota using separate contexts. Mobile 390px dialog fit without horizontal overflow. Direct file:// navigation blocked by ERR_BLOCKED_BY_ADMINISTRATOR in harness; no installed Unity, real Android/Windows or owner acceptance.
sources: Owner-delivered MMHT-12 and verified MMHT-13/14 artifacts

next_action: Owner reviews the complete 15-cycle standalone Map Maker HTML suite and determines any subsequent consolidation or successor work through a new owner-directed scope. No automatic MMHT-16 is selected.
successor_rule: MMHT-15 concludes the approved program sequence; new work requires owner direction and governed scope.
